summary: Re:Zero season 1 (rows 1-25) is Arcs 1-3 of the LIGHT NOVEL and it maps onto MF文庫J volumes 1 → 9 in order, with no reorder at the volume level and no gap: eps 1-3 = v1 (Arc 1's only volume), eps 4-7 = v2 and eps 8-11 = v3 (Arc 2), eps 12-13 = v4, eps 14-15 = v5, eps 16-18 = v6, eps 19-21 = v7, eps 22-23 = v8, eps 24-25 = v9 (Arc 3). ALL TWENTY-FIVE ROWS ARE ANCHORED in LN VOLUME space (end_chapter / start_chapter / volume = the volume number; chapters_adapted = the units inside it as the PRINTED contents page numbers them), all at high confidence, and there are no anchor-hostile rows. Two rows cross a volume seam and carry the START back a volume under A10 — ep 19 → 7 [6] (its first act is v6's last chapter 第六章『配られたカード』, and volume 7 opens on a chapter with the identical title: the alliance meeting is split across the two books) and ep 22 → 8 [7] (its first act is the rest of v7 第六章『メイザース領への道』). The arc bracket was verified rather than assumed: ja-WP's 既刊一覧 備考 column prints 第一章 on v1, 第二章 on v2-3 and 第三章 on v4-9. All twenty-five rows are CONFIRMED CANON as stored — twenty-one of the twenty-five episode titles are printed light-novel chapter titles, the licensor's twenty-five synopses and Kadokawa's nine volume blurbs are light-novel plot throughout, and the only anime-only material any source names is a set of slivers (a rooftop cold open, three gag scenes in the double-length premiere, a Rem rampage, two re-staged deaths, one moved speech, three reaction shots) recorded as divergence under T28's faithfulness clause. The one real structure finding is a documented un-cross-cut: v7 第五章『ヴィルヘルム・ヴァン・アストレア』 is printed AFTER the battle chapters and is cut into them across eps 20-21 (ep 20 is titled with that chapter and the en wiki lists 'Ch 3, 5' for it), so both rows carry a rearranged annotation; no position moves because both are inside v7. THE EP 25 / 26 SEAM: v9 closes this block and ep 25 does NOT finish it — the row stops at the end of 第五章『――ただそれだけの物語』, leaving 幕間『竜車でのひと時』, 断章『ナツキ・レム』, 幕間『イタダキマス』 and 第六章『それぞれの、誓い』 to ep 26, which is titled with that last chapter's name and whose own page reads 'Volume 9 (Interlude-Ch 6)'; so the continue is INSIDE v9 (C1), equal to the END, which is derived and not stored — no continue point is delivered on any row. NO REPAIRS: the stored titles and dates are confirmed on AFL, MAL and ja-WP, and rezero.fandom's one-day-earlier dates are the 日曜深夜 programming-day convention, not a defect.

type_corrections.why: CONFIRMED AS STORED — all twenty-five rows are canon against the series' identified source, the MF文庫J light novel 長月達平『Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活』 (T24 / T25), and no row is mixed or filler. The ask says the types stand and they do; this is the positive evidence rather than an inherited label. (1) POSITION: every one of the twenty-five rows anchors inside volumes 1-9, the six-volume Arc-3 bracket plus Arcs 1-2, on four separately-edited Re:Zero wikis' per-episode volume fields (en / es / ru / zh) and ja-WP's 既刊一覧 arc column. (4) NO ORIGINAL STRETCH: the only anime-only material any source names is a set of slivers — a rooftop cold open, three gag scenes in the double-length premiere, a Rem rampage, two re-staged deaths, one moved speech and three added reaction shots — recorded as divergence under T28's faithfulness clause; there is no episode whose own plot is studio-made, and no recap row (the 総集編 material for this season exists only as the 2020 新編集版 re-cut, which is not a row, I16). Treat them as ONE FAMILY at chapter granularity though: the ru and zh pages are translations of en at older revisions (zh ep 22 still prints the untranslated 'Ch 6'), and where they differ from en they are the coarser claim (eps 20-21). The scans also corrected one wiki reading: volume 2's first chapter is printed 『自覚する感情』, not the 自覚的な感情 an English back-translation suggests. (c) rezero.fandom's 'Volume N/Synopsis' subpages: a chapter-by-chapter plot summary for volumes 1-7 (volume 8's chapter headers are 'To Be Added' and volume 9's synopsis is one unsegmented blob — for those two rows the title test and the licensor's synopses carry the split). The content readings come from the fandom's chapter-by-chapter synopsis of volume 2 matched against en-WP's episode summaries and the licensor's synopses, and they agree with the four wikis' per-episode fields — it is only the titles that are displaced.

Ep 25 ends at the end of volume 9's 第五章『――ただそれだけの物語』 (printed p 179, running to p 251 of a 328-page book — Kadokawa's product page prints ページ数：328; the en wiki's '288 (Japanese)' on that volume page is wrong, 288 is volume 1's count); the four printed units after it — 幕間『竜車でのひと時』(252), 断章『ナツキ・レム』(258), 幕間『イタダキマス』(276) and 第六章『それぞれの、誓い』(292) — are NOT in the 2016 broadcast.
